description: A directory with `pyvenv.cfg`, a `bin/` (or `Scripts\`) directory and its own site-packages, used by an interpreter started from it.
Inside an environment `sys.prefix` is the environment directory and `sys.base_prefix` the base installation; they differ only in an environment.
`key = value` lines read by the interpreter and `site`: `home` names the base interpreter's directory and `include-system-site-packages` adds the base site-packages when it is `true`.
The shell runs the first matching executable in the `PATH` directories, left to right; activation puts the environment's `bin/` first.
A shell script that prepends `bin/` to `PATH`, sets `VIRTUAL_ENV` and changes the prompt; optional, because the environment's interpreter works when called by its path.
`lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages` on POSIX, `Lib\site-packages` on Windows: where installers put packages and where `site` adds them to `sys.path`.
